reasons.GateStateStore.recordValidation: kept per its own doc comment (gate-state-store.ts): the only caller, LightweightGateSystem.validateContent, was deleted with GateValidator when every criteria type moved to a pipeline stage, leaving getSystemHealth's totalValidations/successRate/lastValidationTime fields with no producer. Deleting the writer without the health fields would leave a reader describing a number nothing computes; revives when 20-gate-review-stage.ts wires in ground-truth results, or gets killed together with the health fields in a follow-up row (R36, P4.52, 2026-09-17).
reasons.GateAccumulator.getBySource: sole test-observation window for add()'s live dedup/priority-override contract at entry-source granularity; getAll() (live, id-only) can't express it (P4.52/R36)
reasons.GateAccumulator.getEntries: sole test-observation window for add()'s live dedup/priority-override contract at entry-priority/metadata granularity; getAll() (live, id-only) can't express it (P4.52/R36)
reasons.GateAccumulator.getEntry: sole test-observation window for a single entry's live retryLimit metadata written by add(); getAll() (live, id-only) can't express it (P4.52/R36)
reasons.GateAccumulator.has: sole test-observation window for add()'s live existence-after-dedup contract; kept alongside getEntries/getEntry/getBySource for the same reason (P4.52/R36)
reasons.EnhancedLogger.initLogFile: reached only through a duck-typed cast the static walker can't resolve: runtime/context.ts calls `(logger as any).initLogFile()` behind a `typeof ... === 'function'` guard, for every logger `createLogger()` returns (P4.52, 2026-09-20).
reasons.EnhancedLogger.logStartupInfo: live duplicate at ServerLifecycle.logSystemInfo (infra/http/index.ts): logs the identical pid/node-version/cwd facts inline instead of calling this method. Two answers to one question is evidence of a defect, not surplus; left un-wired pending an owner call on which is canonical (P4.52 reimplementation probe, 2026-09-20).
reasons.EnhancedLogger.logMemoryUsage: live duplicate at ServerLifecycle.logSystemInfo (infra/http/index.ts): logs the identical `Server process memory usage: ${JSON.stringify(process.memoryUsage())}` string inline instead of calling this method (P4.52 reimplementation probe, 2026-09-20).
reasons.ArgumentHistoryTracker.getLatestArgument: live duplicate at ArgumentHistoryTracker.buildReviewContext (same file): independently derives the identical value (last history entry's originalArgs, spread into a new object) inline instead of calling this method (P4.52 reimplementation probe, 2026-09-20).
reasons.ChainSessionStore.updateStepResult: live duplicate at ChainSessionStore.updateSessionState (same file): both update a step's result/metadata and persist, but only updateSessionState is called by 18-execution-stage/step-capture-service. Deleting this one would also orphan TextReferenceStore.getChainStepMetadata, whose sole caller this is, in a class outside this row's scope (P4.52 reimplementation probe, 2026-09-20).
reasons.ServerLifecycle.restart: live duplicate at Application.restartServer (runtime/application.ts), wired to system_control's maintenance action: a different but complete restart strategy (shutdown + process.exit(100) for an external process manager) answering the same question as this method's in-process HTTP close-and-relisten (P4.52 reimplementation probe, 2026-09-20).
reasons.PerformanceMonitor.getMetricsHistory: AnalyticsService (infra/observability/metrics/analytics-service.ts) is a live, constructed, wired-in periodic performance collector (setInterval-driven memory tracking) doing the same job as this whole class; restored rather than left deleted per the P4.52 reimplementation probe, 2026-09-20 — see monitor.ts header.
reasons.PerformanceMonitor.getPerformanceSummary: see PerformanceMonitor.getMetricsHistory — same class, same AnalyticsService duplicate (P4.52, 2026-09-20).
reasons.PerformanceMonitor.onAlert: see PerformanceMonitor.getMetricsHistory — same class, same AnalyticsService duplicate (P4.52, 2026-09-20).
reasons.PerformanceMonitor.startMonitoring: see PerformanceMonitor.getMetricsHistory — same class, same AnalyticsService duplicate (P4.52, 2026-09-20).
reasons.PendingConfirmationTracker.hasPending: sole non-destructive test-observation window for pending-confirmation state: checkAndClearPending clears on match (single-use), so hasPending is the only way tests assert a pending confirmation exists without consuming it — 10 call sites in pending-confirmation-tracker.test.ts (P4.52, 2026-09-20).
reasons.PendingConfirmationTracker.clear: has its own dedicated behavioral test (multi-entry clear + hasPending verification), not merely incidental teardown; kept as tested capability alongside hasPending (P4.52, 2026-09-20).
